links.title: LWPL — League Rules
links.description: London Water Polo League rules. Matches follow FINA/Swim England rules where practical (rule 4.33), with local exceptions in 4.34: four quarters of at least 7 minutes, 30/20 shot clock where possible, 2-minute interval, and pitch size limited by the pool. Referee duties, quotas, match sheets, expenses and sanctions are in sections 4.10–4.20, 4.35–4.40 and Appendix III.

links.title: LWPL — Referee Sanctions Report
links.description: Form for referees to report a sanction from a fixture they officiated. LWPL escalates reports to Swim England’s Office of Judicial Administration.

links.title: LWPL — Summer 2026 Referee Allocations
links.description: Published referee appointments for LWPL Summer 2026 fixtures.

links.title: LWPL — Match Sheets
links.description: Official match-sheet folders. Referees must check the sheet before play and sign it at the end, recording disciplinary issues and expenses (rules 4.20, 4.38, 4.40).

links.title: World Aquatics — Water Polo Rules (landing page)
links.description: Official World Aquatics (formerly FINA) water polo rules hub.

links.title: World Aquatics — Competition Regulations
links.description: Current and archived competition regulations. Current version: February 2026 (updated 18 Feb 2026). Water polo is Part Six; referee signals are Appendix 2.

links.title: World Aquatics — Competition Regulations PDF (Feb 2026)
links.description: Full current regulations PDF. Water polo starts at Part Six (p.214). Technical officials p.216; ordinary/exclusion/penalty fouls p.227–233; signals Appendix 2 p.247; VAR Appendix 4; coach’s challenge Appendix 5.

links.title: World Aquatics — Water Polo Extract (June 2025)
links.description: Water polo-only extract of the June 2025 regulations (the version Swim England applied to English clubs from 1 July 2025). Useful shorter reading than the full book.

links.title: June 2025 Rule Changes — Summary
links.description: Short summary of the June 2025 changes: 25m pitch, 14-player squads, 28/18 possession, improper re-entry as a penalty, timeout/restart and goalkeeper-substitution updates. Compare with LWPL 4.34 local exceptions.

links.title: July 2025 Rules — Tracked Changes
links.description: World Aquatics water polo rules with tracked changes, useful for seeing what moved.
